summary: P0-F.10 Isolation Driver + Policy + Console validated end-to-end. Backend unit suite backend/tests/edr/test_p0_f10_isolation.py = 14/14 PASS (policy default is labelled PLATFORM_DEFAULT_NOT_YET_REVIEWED with auto_release_seconds=null and control_channel_mode=SENSOR_API_ENDPOINT; put_policy versioning; ValueError on empty verification target; ISOLATE_ENDPOINT lifecycle carries the AUTHORIZED step + bound policy while KILL_PROCESS keeps the P0-F.5 two-step start with authorisation=null; dual-proof grader — rules-installed-but-not-effective, control-channel-lost, single-sided probe = VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE; release requires rules_absent AND external_restored; expire_isolations raises a NEW AUTHORIZED release command by policy:auto_release rather than flipping state on a timer; sensor _isolation_capability names CAP_NET_ADMIN exactly; self-lockout refusal CONTROL_CHANNEL_UNRESOLVED; control channel is always merged into the applied allow-list; _nft_ruleset is default-deny on all three hooks). Live-API probe backend/tests/edr/test_p0_f10_live_api.py = 7/7 PASS on the preview URL (GET/PUT /api/edr/response/isolation-policy require auth 401; read shape carries invariants (>=3) + SENSOR_API_ENDPOINT + labelled policy_source; PUT bumps version and flips to OPERATOR_CONFIGURED and preserves unchanged fields on a partial write; PUT with {host:'',port:0} returns 400 INVALID_POLICY; POST /api/edr/response/actions ISOLATE_ENDPOINT returns state=AUTHORIZED with history [REQUESTED,AUTHORIZED], authorisation.control_channel_protected=true, authorised_by/policy_version/policy_source/basis all present, target.policy carrying allow-list + verification target; KILL_PROCESS never returns AUTHORIZED). Acceptance proof script python3 /app/scripts/p0_f10_isolation_proof.py exits 0 with the honest CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE branch: outcome=CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE, detail names 'MISSING_PRIVILEGE: CAP_NET_ADMIN', verification=null, external target still reachable, endpoint NOT recorded as isolated. Console /xdr/admin/edr-response: ISOLATION POLICY block collapsed by default with edr-isolation-policy-toggle expander; policy-source badge shows 'OPERATOR_CONFIGURED · v6' → after Save 'OPERATOR_CONFIGURED · v7' (version bumps live). Fields data-testid=edr-isolation-{allow-list,verify-host,verify-port,allow-dns,auto-release,policy-save,invariants} all present; auto-release is blank by default; Allow DNS while contained checked; INVARIANTS block titled 'INVARIANTS — NOT SETTINGS' with 4 items. Save with empty verify-host surfaces edr-isolation-policy-error showing the exact backend refusal ('a verification target (host + port) is required…') rather than appearing to succeed. Expanded ISOLATE_ENDPOINT record shows full audit chain: AUTHORISATION with 'authorised by admin@nivxray.com' + 'authorised at' timestamp + 'isolation policy v6 (OPERATOR_CONFIGURED)' + 'control channel protected by invariant' + basis + reason 'P0-F.10 acceptance proof'; TARGET block renders 'NOT A PROCESS ACTION — this action targets the endpoint itself, so there is no process identity to bind' (edr-response-not-process present); LIFECYCLE REQUESTED → AUTHORIZED → DISPATCHED → CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with sensor claim 'MISSING_PRIVILEGE: CAP_NET_ADMIN — cannot enforce network containment'; INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION shows 'NO POST-ACTION EVIDENCE — nothing about the effect is proven'; FINAL RESULT badge CAPABILITY_NOT_PRESENT. Header stats: actions=15, verified=5, claimed-not-verified=0, refused/failed=2, capability_unavailable=8, integrity_alarms=0 — matches API. Regression P0-F.5/F.6: the 5 VERIFIED KILL_PROCESS rows still render with their full identity+timeline and integrity alarms stay at 0; /xdr/admin/edr-enrollment loads cleanly with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: isolation_policy.PLATFORM_DEFAULT does ship a verification_target={host:1.1.1.1,port:443} so the very first GET already has a target — the 'no verification target' refusal only applies to explicit writes, which is correct because get_policy() returns the shipped default and the UI would otherwise never let the operator save without picking one. Good.

edr_response router PUT wraps ValueError → 400 INVALID_POLICY {detail:{error,reason}} and the console consumes it as visible policy-save error text — matches P0-F.6's existing error-envelope shape. Consistent.

The expanded ISOLATE_ENDPOINT record correctly omits the proof-control_plane / proof-behavioural blocks when there is no probe (CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE has none) and shows 'NO POST-ACTION EVIDENCE' instead — the honesty rule from P0-F.6 is preserved for isolation.

expire_isolations() creating a NEW AUTHORIZED RELEASE_ISOLATION command with requested_by='policy:auto_release' (instead of silently flipping state) is the correct owner-mandated behaviour; the endpoint stays ISOLATED until that release is independently verified. Confirmed by unit test test_no_auto_release_by_default_and_a_timeout_raises_a_command.
seed_data_creation: Running scripts/p0_f10_isolation_proof.py added one AUTHORIZED→CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE ISOLATE_ENDPOINT record on ep_2d57cbe6f80152062109; the live-API test raised one more identical record. Policy version advanced 6 → 7 via a UI save. No verified/successful isolation was created (honest by design).
